Live version of the OTHE CRM technician app for Android, signed with the permanent OTHE key.

**What's new**
- No more Android "New tag scanned" screen after a Tap to Pay payment
- The phone back button works inside the app
- Opens https://ontimehomexpertscrm.com
- Same Tap to Pay / card reader setup as v1.0.0 (Stripe Terminal 5.8.1)

**Install (technicians)**
1. Delete the old OTHE CRM app (one time only — v1.0.0 used a different key).
2. Download **OTHE-CRM-1.1.1.apk** below and open it → Install.
3. Open the app and log in.

Future versions install straight over this one.
